policy: Fresh upstream author families acquired after detector freeze; no tuning/reference updates from this holdout; failure and partial scans included
limitations: 8 repository author families and 22 primary source units, compilation variants correlated; no new DES/RC4/ChaCha20 implementations; SM4 only one JS source unit, insufficient for a broad SM4 accuracy claim. Headers are support, not independent labels. No target code is executed.

excluded.kokke/tiny-regex-c: Author already represented by historical tiny-AES development
excluded.Cyan4973/xxHash: Historical smhasher validation includes this family; excluded before scan
excluded.BLAKE3-team/BLAKE3: Historical smhasher validation includes this family; excluded before scan
excluded.kmackay/micro-ecc: Same author and exact version found under historical samples/stripped-repair; excluded before scanner runs
excluded.smuellerDD/leancrypto: New SHA implementation but author appears in historical libgcrypt random code; conservatively excluded from strict author holdout
excluded.NEWPLAN/SMx: SM4 resembles widely redistributed PolarSSL-style lineage; independence unresolved. Excluded before scan.
